NEWS: xAI's Grok 4.3 takes the #1 spot on IFBench, the leading instruction-following benchmark, according to Artificial Analysis.

Grok scored 81%, beating every major competitor:

MiMo-V2.5-Pro at 80%
Gemini 3 Flash at 78%
Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview at 77%
GPT-5.5 (Xhigh) at 76%
GPT-5.4 (xhigh) at 74%
Claude Opus 4.7 (max) at 59%

This is Grok's latest top finish on the benchmark, which measures how closely a model follows user instructions.

UPDATE Grok 4.3 is now live on the xAI API

It is the fastest and most capable Grok model so far with strong gains in reasoning and tool use.

It ranks #1 in agentic tool calling and instruction following and leads enterprise benchmarks in case law and corporate finance.

The model supports a 1 million token context window which allows much longer inputs and deeper workflows.

Pricing is set at $1.25 per million input tokens and $2.50 per million output tokens.

Developers can create an API key and start building immediately.
